title: Cabir: The First Mobile Phone Worm (2004)
explainer: Cabir, discovered in 2004, was among the first worms written to spread between mobile phones rather than desktop computers, targeting Nokia devices running the Symbian OS and propagating over Bluetooth. It caused little practical damage, but it demonstrated that mobile devices were viable malware targets years before modern smartphones existed, previewing the entire category of mobile-specific threats — malicious or over-permissioned apps among them — that mobile app security practice exists to defend against today.
